text:
Noah (marketing PM): Quick sync — CedarBridge case draft landed in the drive. Two quote takes from the interview. Need legal ok + customer signoff by Mon EOD if we want to run the piece Wednesday morning. Also planning a co-hosted demo/webinar with them on May 16 — who will own registration + landing page + invites?

Riya (producer): I can own the landing page and assets. Timeline I\tm thinking: hero quote by Tue noon, transcript cleanup Tue afternoon, design polish Wed morning.

Priya (legal): Paste the exact quote copy here. Any explicit percentages or multipliers need a source doc attached or we need to change to qualitative language. Also confirm we have a signed media release for CedarBridge logo.

Noah (marketing PM): Quote A and B below. A is verbatim from the customer call, B is a short hero variant.

Riya (producer): ```Quote A: "After switching to Redwood, our inference bill dropped by about 70% and 99th-percentile latency improved dramatically — we launched features much faster."```

Priya (legal): Flags: "70%" and "99th-percentile" are quantitative. Either attach the benchmark appendix (with methodology) or change to non-numeric phrases like "substantial reduction in inference cost" and "material latency improvements." "launched features much faster" -> "accelerated feature launches." Also confirm we have written logo permission.

Diego (growth): For inbound routing: can we tag demo requests with cedarbridge_launch and route them to the cedar_sdr queue? I'll add a nurture drip and set up tracking. Need UTM pattern for the webinar landing page.

publishing-bot: Created ticket MKT-735: "CedarBridge case + webinar setup" and assigned to Riya.

Riya (producer): Short hero candidate: ```"CedarBridge reduced inference spend and sped up feature launches with Redwood."```

Priya (legal): Short hero OK with edits: change "sped up" -> "accelerated" and "reduced inference spend" -> "reduced inference costs." Final: "CedarBridge accelerated feature launches and reduced inference costs with Redwood." Approved pending signed media release and customer OK on wording.

Noah (marketing PM): Great. @Diego please confirm the SDR queue and opt-in copy for webinar signups. @Riya I need the final hero text in the launch Figma by Wed 9am so we can lock design. I'm pinging the CedarBridge contacts for quote signoff and logo permission now.

Diego (growth): Confirmed queue cedar_sdr exists. Opt-in snippet: "By registering you consent to be contacted by Redwood about product updates and demos." UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=cedarbridge_launch. I'll add the tag cedarbridge_launch and a two-email nurture.

Riya (producer): Figma link: https://redwood.app/figma/cedarbridge-case-hero — I'll drop frames for hero, social cards, and webinar banner by Tue noon.

Noah (marketing PM): Please react to confirm. Priya: paste legal approval here once the signed media release is confirmed and we've got the customer's published quote confirmation.

Priya (legal): Approved as edited. :white_check_mark: Waiting on signed media release (client legal emailed back, they said "we'll return by EOD Monday").

publishing-bot: If customer signoff received before Mon 23:59 UTC, publish scheduled for Wed 10:00 UTC and webinar invites sent Mon after final assets are uploaded.

Noah (marketing PM): Thanks team — I'll follow up with CedarBridge and update this thread when we get the signed release.
